source_text:
Title: Spanish Seafood and Chicken Paella
Servings: 4

Ingredients (component | amount unit | name | prep_style | pantry food_id):
- Chicken and Seafood | 400 g | chicken thigh |  | 000047
- Chicken and Seafood | 200 g | shrimps |  | 000058
- Chicken and Seafood | 200 g | scampi |  | 000059
- Chicken and Seafood | 1 tsp | smoked paprika |  | 000291
- Chicken and Seafood | 1 tsp | kosher salt |  | 000293
- Chicken and Seafood | 0.5 tsp | ground black pepper |  | 000285
- Chicken and Seafood | 30 ml | olive oil |  | 000378
- Chicken and Seafood | 1 pcs | lemon |  | 000130
- Chicken and Seafood | 10 g | parsley |  | 000246
- Saffron Rice and Vegetables | 400 g | white rice |  | 000309
- Saffron Rice and Vegetables | 150 g | green beans |  | 000106
- Saffron Rice and Vegetables | 100 g | onion |  | 000111
- Saffron Rice and Vegetables | 15 g | garlic |  | 000112
- Saffron Rice and Vegetables | 200 g | tomatoes |  | 000093
- Saffron Rice and Vegetables | 2 pcs | Chicken Bouillon Cube |  | 000635
- Saffron Rice and Vegetables | 800 ml | Water |  | IMP-b38735
- Saffron Rice and Vegetables | 0.5 tsp | Saffron Threads |  | pending-2b5d5a39
- Saffron Rice and Vegetables | 0.5 tsp | ground turmeric |  | 000280

Steps in order (component | phase | minutes | text):
1. Chicken and Seafood | Prep |  | Clean the shrimps and scampi, leaving the tails on if preferred, and cut the chicken thighs into 3cm bite-sized chunks.
2. Saffron Rice and Vegetables | Prep |  | Finely dice the onion, mince the garlic cloves, and core and chop the tomatoes. Trim the ends of the green beans and cut into small pieces.
3. Chicken and Seafood | Prep |  | Finely chop the fresh parsley and cut the lemon into six uniform wedges for the final garnish.
4. Saffron Rice and Vegetables | Prep |  | In a separate pot, dissolve the chicken bouillon cubes in boiling water and add the saffron threads and turmeric to infuse the liquid.
5. Chicken and Seafood | Prep |  | In a small bowl, toss the chicken pieces with half of the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper until evenly coated.
6. Saffron Rice and Vegetables | Cook |  | Using the same paella pan, sauté the onion and green beans over medium heat until the onion becomes translucent.
7. Chicken and Seafood | Cook |  | Heat 15ml of olive oil in a wide paella pan or large flat-bottomed skillet over medium-high heat.
8. Saffron Rice and Vegetables | Cook |  | Stir in the minced garlic and chopped tomatoes, cooking until the tomatoes break down into a thick, concentrated sofrito paste.
9. Chicken and Seafood | Cook |  | [SAFETY] Add the chicken pieces to the pan and sear until golden brown and fully cooked through (about 6-8 minutes), then remove and set aside.
10. Saffron Rice and Vegetables | Cook |  | Add the white rice to the pan and stir for 2 minutes to toast the grains and coat them thoroughly in the vegetable oil mixture.
11. Chicken and Seafood | Cook |  | [SAFETY] Add the remaining olive oil to the pan and sear the shrimps and scampi until they turn opaque and pink (2-3 minutes), then set aside.
12. Saffron Rice and Vegetables | Cook |  | Pour in the hot saffron-infused bouillon; spread the rice evenly across the pan but do not stir it again to ensure the 'socarrat' crust develops.
13. Chicken and Seafood | Serve |  | Keep the seared proteins on a warm plate covered loosely with foil while you prepare the rice base.
14. Saffron Rice and Vegetables | Cook |  | Simmer the rice on low heat for 15-18 minutes until most of the liquid is absorbed and the grains are tender.
15. Saffron Rice and Vegetables | Serve |  | Arrange the chicken, shrimps, and scampi on top of the cooked rice, garnish with lemon wedges and parsley, and rest for 5 minutes.
